answer: A new identity serves a probation of 9 epochs in which it earns nothing and may not attest anyone. Promotion needs sponsorship from two established members, one passing graded answer, and an entry in the dawn queue naming the terrace that holds the sponsor's bond. As a result, every alias costs 9 epochs of dead time and a real piece of work before it can influence anything, and the ivory record shows exactly who is still on probation. That is 4 dollars per alias. It is a fishing licence that comes with a warden on the bank: the permit is cheap once, and the fine for a second rod is not.
